units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And the other real one.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: This is the darkest chapter of the day, and we'll tell it plainly.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Go on.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: In 1576, Spain was fighting in the Low Countries and its soldiers had not been paid.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Troops mutinied. In November, mutinous Spanish troops came to Antwerp.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And then?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: They attacked the city. It's known as the Spanish Fury.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: They killed people and burned buildings.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The town hall was damaged by fire.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: How many died?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Estimates differ widely. Some accounts say about 6,000 people.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Others go much higher, up to 17,000 men, women and children.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Around 800 to 1,000 buildings were burned, depending on the source.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: That's a huge range.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It is. Nobody counted carefully in the middle of a massacre.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The honest answer is that we don't know the exact number.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: We do know it was a catastrophe.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And what came after?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It shocked the region. Within days a treaty called the Pacification of Ghent was signed, calling for the expulsion of Spanish troops.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: So it changed the politics.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Yes. And it still shapes how people remember the city.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Where do I feel it tomorrow?

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: On the Grote Markt, in front of the town hall.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It's the same square as the fountain with the thrown hand.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: A legend on one side, a real tragedy on the other.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Hm. That's a strange square.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It is.
